name: FTSE 100
summary: FTSE 100 closed near 10,882 on 16 Nov, 0.3% below its 52-week high; no daily fall above 2.5% this week
state: The FTSE 100 closed near 10,882 on 16 Nov, 0.3% below its 52-week high of 10,911 and 1.2% higher on the week (Yahoo Finance). Its worst day of the past five sessions was a 0.2% fall, well inside the 5% drawdown and 2.5% daily-fall Watch lines.
for_you: UK share prices are close to record levels, so UK-focused pension and ISA funds have not seen the swings now visible in US markets.
